title: Graham Stewart and the Curtain Call and Gas House gigs
summary: Small low-paid gigs with trombonist Graham Stewart.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: So you were playing on and off. Were you playing with a Graham Stewart?
Graham is a trombone player. He was in that band with Tony Parenti at the Curtain Call on 52nd Street.
And also with Bobby Pratt... Well, you were playing at the Curtain Call.
And he was playing down at a place called the Gas House.
Yeah. At 16th Street and First Avenue.
Oh yeah. That's no longer there, is it. I remember reading about that.
Then it turned to another name.

First Avenue, yeah. But he was down there a long time. He wasn't going to make no money(?). On Thursday nights. Just to be doing something until something good come along, you know. I'd get fifteen or twenty dollars.
In other words, even during the Seventies it was pretty much the way it had been during the Sixties.
